His posture is relaxed with slightly sloped shoulders, his weight supported by the luxury vehicle behind him and his left foot planted on the ground while his right ankle crosses casually over his left. To the right of the vehicle, an open sidewalk paved with rectangular light beige-gray concrete slabs creates an asymmetric, layered balance, while a matte black Victorian-style metal street lamp with a glass lantern top rises directly behind the subject. The deep background reveals a quiet, upscale London-style residential neighborhood featuring matte off-white stucco-rendered masonry and painted brick architecture; on the left stands a smooth-textured townhouse adorned with an ornate black wrought-iron balcony railing, and on the right stretches a slightly weathered cream garden wall displaying subtle vertical water streaking beneath coping stones, a classical stone balustrade, a black paneled door, and an exterior wall sconce. Along the upper right wall ledge sits a row of brown terracotta pots thriving with trailing pink geraniums and green foliage, while dense, dark forest-green deciduous trees and climbing ivy frame the upper portion of the scene. The environment is bathed in soft, moderate, natural overcast daylight from a single diffused overhead sky source coming from above and slightly to the left, supplemented by ambient bounce fill from the surrounding white walls and reflective car body. This neutral-to-cool lighting casts short shadows with soft, gradual edges that gently sculpt the right side of the subject's face and deepen into gray and black beneath the car chassis, while preserving specular highlights across his forehead, cheekbone, the glossy car hood, and the windshield. Dominated by a cool, neutral color palette of off-white, charcoal, deep navy, forest green, heather gray, and a subtle light blue accent, the image exhibits moderate saturation and low-to-medium contrast, evoking a calm, sophisticated, and affluent old-money lifestyle mood. Shot straight-on with a 35mm lens at f/4, ISO 200, and a 1/250s shutter speed, this clean, grain-free digital photograph maintains tack-sharp focus on the subject's clothing textures and the smooth glossy vehicle while rendering the identifiable background architecture in a slightly soft, deep depth of field, finished with post-processing that preserves natural skin tones alongside a subtle contrast boost, slightly cooled highlights, and muted foliage greens, all framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.

entries.title: Quilled-Paper Sculptures: 4 Days That Changed History
entries.titleZh: 衍纸雕塑：改变历史的 4 天
entries.prompt:

FUSION_RULES = {
    "flow_analysis": "compute edge-direction field θ and curvature field κ across $ SUBJECT; derive flow vector field F = ∇θ; curl(F) drives coil tightness, divergence(F) drives coil spacing",
    "strip_conversion": "convert every streamline of F into a tightly coiled quilling strip; coil radius = 1/|κ| at that point; strip follows the flow without breaking it",
    "recursion": "each large coil recursively contains 2–4 smaller nested coils aligned to the same local flow direction; recursion depth capped so the silhouette stays readable",
    "material": "dyed paper quilling strips, satin finish, low specular, visible fibrous edges; gilded tips (gold leaf) at terminal ends of strips only; no other material",
    "support": "shallow white plinth, no visible armature, no wire, no plastic",
    "lighting": "global illumination + soft top fill; hard raking key from ~20° above horizon, aligned to F; reveals micro-relief on every coil edge and paper fiber",
    "camera": "shallow DOF f/1.8; focal plane on the nearest coil edge cluster; paper fibers resolved at the focal plane; background coils fall into soft bokeh",
    "result": "a quilled-paper sculpture of $ SUBJECT in which every curve becomes nested spirals of razor-clean paper geometry",
    "negative": "wire armature, plastic, glossy resin, painted illustration, flat 2D, 3D render sheen, blurred paper fibers, random coils off-flow, pasted-on decoration"

entries.prompt:
Create a premium overseas luxury jewelry campaign poster for original brand NOIRÉLIA, centered on THE VEIL RELIC COLLECTION. The image is a full-bleed vertical 2x2 editorial macro collage with dark beauty photography, black negative space, tactile lace, wet skin highlights, black satin glove texture, pearl-crystal jewelry, and a glossy black scarab brooch. The concept is quiet dark ornament: beauty hidden in shadow through intimate fragments of face, hand, skin, lace, pearl, and black crystal.

Divide the poster into four equal rectangular panels with clean internal seams and no outer decorative border. Use extreme macro close-up framing in every panel. Upper-left: a 20+ adult model’s eyes and upper face partly veiled by black lace. Upper-right: a black satin-gloved hand holding one pearl between the fingers, with a fine crystal bracelet at the wrist. Lower-left: a glossy black scarab-shaped brooch resting on textured skin or matte black fabric, wrapped with a fine crystal chain. Lower-right: a macro profile of lips, nose, and cheek with a black crystal thorn face chain crossing the skin.

Keep one restrained dark editorial rhythm across all panels: black backgrounds, tight cropping, high tactile detail, and selective highlights. Remove any large central headline. Let the middle seam stay clean so the four macro images breathe. Tiny brand text appears only in one or two corners, never spanning across the image. The eye, pearl, scarab brooch, and face chain create four quiet focal points without typographic interruption.

The hero products are NOIRÉLIA’s luxury accessories: black lace veil mask, pearl-crystal bracelet, glossy black scarab brooch, and black crystal thorn face chain. Each object must feel physically credible and commercially manufacturable: visible lace fibers, sharp crystal facets, softly reflective pearl surface, glossy sculptural black enamel scarab shell, and tiny precise metal settings. Brand identity comes from material consistency and minimal corner text, not a large slogan.

Use only 20+ adult models with mature non-childlike facial features. Skin is realistic, with natural pores, soft highlights, and believable anatomy. Expressions are restrained and editorial: calm eyes, relaxed lips, no exaggerated seduction, no open-mouth pose. Hands must have correct anatomy, natural knuckles, clean nails, and believable finger pressure around the pearl.

The lace crosses the eyes without hiding the gaze. The satin glove creates a matte-dark field around the single pearl. The scarab brooch sits diagonally, with the crystal chain draped across its shell and body. The face chain follows cheek and lip contours, catching tiny highlights without cutting unnaturally into the skin. No large text should interrupt seams or cover jewelry.

Backgrounds are deep black, charcoal grey, and muted shadow with no room details. Depth comes from macro focus, skin texture, lace layers, satin folds, jewelry reflections, and shallow falloff into darkness. Keep the collage minimal: no extra flowers, no insects other than the brooch, no cluttered fashion props, no decorative frame, no social handles.

Use narrow directional soft light from upper left and very small specular jewelry highlights. Palette: 75% black and charcoal, 12% skin bronze and muted warm highlights, 8% pearl white and crystal sparkle, 5% silver-black metal glints. The pearl and crystal points provide contrast; black lace, satin glove, and enamel carry the dark brand identity. Shadows stay detailed, never dead black over jewelry or facial features.

Render as high-end macro editorial photography. Lace shows fine mesh, frayed threads, and scalloped edges. Satin glove shows soft folded sheen, not plastic shine. Skin is luminous and real, never plastic. Pearl is softly reflective; crystals are sharp and faceted; black enamel scarab has curved glossy reflections and tiny carved leg details. Any typography is tiny, crisp, perfectly spaced, and not distressed.

Use only English text, extremely minimal. No large central headline. Upper-left corner, tiny thin uppercase:
“NOIRÉLIA”
Lower-right corner, tiny thin uppercase:
“VEIL RELIC”
Optional bottom-left micro category line:
“LACE / PEARL / BLACK CRYSTAL”
Do not add social handles, slogans, artist names, fake awards, prices, certifications, random small print, copied phrases, real brand marks, real product names, or real person names.

entries.title: Photo-to-Ink Editorial Poster
entries.titleZh: 照片转黑白墨线编辑海报
entries.prompt:
Using the uploaded reference image, create a single high-resolution vertical 2:3 editorial art poster.

Divide the canvas into two perfectly equal horizontal sections, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height. Separate them with a clean, perfectly straight horizontal dividing line.

1. TOP HALF — ORIGINAL REFERENCE PHOTOGRAPH

Use the uploaded reference photograph directly in the upper 50% of the poster.

Preserve its original photographic quality, sharpness, natural lighting, and color relationships.

Allow only subtle, intelligent cropping around the outer edges when necessary, without compromising the main subject.

If required, naturally extend a small portion of the surrounding environment to fit the composition.

Do not redraw, illustrate, stretch, blur, or modify the subject's appearance, structure, or spatial relationships.

Do not introduce black borders, white margins, or empty edges.

2. BOTTOM HALF — MINIMALIST EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION

Use a warm, near-white ivory paper background with an extremely subtle paper texture.

Analyze the main subject and visual story of the uploaded reference image.

Extract only the primary subject, preserving one or two essential identifying elements.

Remove or heavily simplify all secondary details, including background architecture, crowds, vehicles, fences, signs, trees, and other unnecessary elements.

Transform the primary subject into a sophisticated black-ink editorial illustration.

ILLUSTRATION STYLE:

Use natural, clean pen strokes with varied line weight.

Preserve an authentic hand-drawn appearance with expressive but controlled linework.

Avoid overly precise engraving aesthetics, excessive internal details, and dense cross-hatching.

Place a large, nearly pure-black rectangular ink block behind the illustrated subject.

The rectangular block should have subtly imperfect, handmade print-style edges.

Keep the black background clean, with only fine paper grain and minimal noise.

Avoid obvious hatching, scratches, architectural lines, or complex textures.

ILLUSTRATION SCALE AND COMPOSITION:

The illustrated subject must occupy approximately 72–77% of the canvas width and 58–64% of the bottom section's height.

Maintain a clear visual focal point with generous negative space surrounding the illustration.

3. COLOR RULES

The bottom illustration must follow a strictly black-and-white color palette by default.

Preserve only one localized accent color if the original reference image contains a clearly distinctive, concentrated color element with meaningful narrative importance.

Ordinary blue skies, green vegetation, stone surfaces, skin tones, and environmental colors must not be treated as accent colors.

Any preserved accent color must remain strictly localized to the relevant subject or area.

Never allow accent colors to spread across the entire illustration.

4. TYPOGRAPHY AND EDITORIAL LAYOUT

Automatically generate concise, meaningful English typography based on the content of the uploaded reference photograph.

The typography must resemble handwritten editorial annotations from an independent art publication.

TOP-LEFT CORNER:

Generate a short handwritten title consisting of 2–5 words, arranged across two lines.

Directly beneath the title, include three short English action verbs relevant to the photograph.

TOP-RIGHT CORNER:

Display only two lines of geographic coordinates:

Latitude
Longitude

Do not include any additional text in this area.

BOTTOM-LEFT CORNER:

Display the location name followed by the word "DIARY."

Directly beneath it, add one short descriptive English sentence inspired by the photograph.

TYPOGRAPHY STYLE:

Use a rough, upright, slightly irregular handwritten typeface.

Maintain subtle imperfections and a natural editorial annotation aesthetic.

Avoid elegant cursive, calligraphy, overly decorative lettering, and excessively polished typography.

5. FINAL ART DIRECTION

The finished poster must combine:

Authentic, high-quality photography.

entries.title: Me and My Chibi: Photo Art
entries.titleZh: 我和我的 Q 版小人：实拍合成
entries.prompt:
添付画像を厳密な人物リファレンスとして使用し、元画像の人物と、その人物をモチーフにした2次元のチビキャラが一緒に楽しく遊んでいる、実写フォトアートを1枚生成してください。

【1. 実写人物の一貫性：最重要】
添付画像の人物本人を、実写の写真として忠実に再現する。顔立ち、目、鼻、口、輪郭、肌の色、髪型、髪色、表情、衣装、アクセサリーなど、元画像の特徴を可能な限り維持する。別人に変えたり、過度に美化したり、アニメ風に変換したりしない。肌は自然な毛穴や繊細な質感を持ち、現実のカメラで撮影した人物写真のようにリアルに仕上げる。

【2. 2次元チビキャラの生成】
実写人物をモデルにした、小さくてかわいい2次元のチビキャラを登場させる。チビキャラは元画像の人物と同じ髪型、髪色、目の特徴、衣装、アクセサリーを持ち、ひと目で同じ人物がモチーフだと分かるデザインにする。頭が大きく、体が小さい、デフォルメされた2〜3頭身のキャラクター。輪郭線がきれいな、完成度の高い日本の2次元アニメイラストとして描く。チビキャラは立体的な3Dフィギュアではなく、明確に平面的な2次元イラストとして表現する。

【3. 2人が一緒に遊ぶシーン】
実写の人物と2次元のチビキャラが、自然な距離感で一緒に遊んでいる様子を描く。チビキャラが人物の手の上にちょこんと座る、人物がチビキャラに優しく触れようとする、一緒に手を振る、顔を見合わせて笑うなど、画像全体に合う自然でかわいらしい交流を表現する。遊び方やポーズは元画像の雰囲気に合わせて選ぶ。チビキャラが単に横に配置されるだけでなく、実写人物と互いに反応し合っていることが明確に伝わる構図にする。人物の存在感と顔の見えやすさを保ち、チビキャラも十分に認識できる大きさにする。

【4. 実写と2次元の美しい融合】
人物は本物の写真と見分けがつかないほどリアルに、チビキャラは鮮明で美しい2次元イラストにする。異なる表現形式を意図的に組み合わせた、洗練されたハイブリッド・フォトアート。光の方向、色調、影、空間の奥行きを自然に統一し、チビキャラが実写空間の中で生き生きと遊んでいるように見せる。チビキャラには適度な接地影や自然な落ち影を加え、人物との位置関係を明確にする。ただし、チビキャラを実写の人形や3D CGに変えない。

【5. 手指・身体の破綻防止：最重要】
人物の手、指、腕、関節を解剖学的に自然で正確に描写する。手指はそれぞれ明確に分離し、自然な長さ、太さ、関節、曲がり方を維持する。指の本数は正確に5本とし、余分な指、欠損した指、融合した指、溶けた指、折れ曲がった不自然な指を生成しない。人物とチビキャラが触れ合う場面では、接触位置と指の配置を明確にする。チビキャラの手も、デザインに合った自然で一貫性のある形にする。手を無理に複雑なポーズにせず、必要に応じて手を軽く開く、手のひらに座らせるなど、破綻しにくいポーズを優先する。腕や指を増やさず、身体のつながりを正しく保つ。

【6. 高画質・滑らかな仕上がり】
高解像度、精細、滑らかでクリアな画質。人物の肌、髪の毛、衣装の繊維、目元などのディテールを自然かつ繊細に表現する。ノイズの少ない、透明感のある高品質な写真表現。過剰なシャープネス、輪郭のギザギザ、ブロック状の圧縮ノイズ、ザラザラした粒子、ガビガビした質感、低解像度、ぼやけ、不自然なディテールの強調を避ける。肌をプラスチックのように加工せず、自然な質感を維持する。チビキャラの輪郭線も滑らかで鮮明に描く。

【7. 光・色彩・芸術性】
プロのファッションフォトグラファーが撮影したような、上質な光、自然な陰影、美しい色彩、丁寧な構図を採用する。人物の魅力を最大限に引き出しながら、チビキャラとの交流がひと目で伝わる印象的な作品にする。背景は元画像の雰囲気を尊重し、人物とチビキャラが引き立つように整える。色彩は鮮やかさと上品さを両立させ、過度なエフェクトや不必要な装飾で画面を散らかさない。

【8. 最終出力の条件】
画像は1枚のみ。人物は実写、チビキャラは2次元イラストという表現の違いを明確に維持する。人物の顔や衣装の特徴を損なわず、2人が一緒に遊んでいる楽しさ、かわいらしさ、温かさが伝わる完成度の高いフォトアートにする。

禁止事項：人物全体のアニメ化、チビキャラの3Dフィギュア化、人物の別人化、顔の過度な加工、手指の破綻、指の本数の異常、余分な腕や手、身体の融合、低解像度、過剰なノイズ、ガビガビした画質、不自然な輪郭、強すぎるシャープネス、安っぽいCG表現、不要な文字や透かし。

entries.titleZh: 四位科学家的实验字标
entries.prompt:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 famous scientists: CONCEPT ANCHOR 1:
"Experimental geometric wordmark — custom-built uppercase
letterforms, monoline geometry, alternating thick and thin
strokes, deliberately interrupted character segments,
mechanically precise shapes, optical alignment,
architectural negative space."

::

CONCEPT ANCHOR 2:
"Semantic symbol typography — recognizable visual symbols
integrated directly into the anatomy of letters, including
modified counters, transformed stems, symbolic crossbars,
illustrative terminals, and conceptual ligatures."

::

CONCEPT ANCHOR 3:
"Vintage scientific and engineering lettering — parallel
technical lines, concentric rings, rotational diagrams,
rhythmic stroke repetition, exploded mechanical shapes,
technical-drawing precision, scientific schematic clarity."

::

CONCEPT ANCHOR 4:
"Swiss modernist minimalist identity — immaculate white
background, pure black graphic elements, striking negative
space, precisely controlled typography, asymmetrical visual
balance, intellectually playful reduction."

INSTRUCTION:

Find the precise visual intersection of these four concepts.

Ignore the literal technological terminology
and subject matter in the references.

Extract only their visual design DNA.

Create an extraordinary experimental typographic
wordmark for $ SUBJECT.

The letters must become an intelligent visual
expression of the subject's defining meaning.

This is not ordinary text decorated with icons.

The word itself must transform into a symbolic
piece of visual engineering.

SUBJECT ANALYSIS:

First determine:

1. The most recognizable word or short phrase
   representing $ SUBJECT.

2. Its strongest defining visual characteristic.

3. Its dominant conceptual properties.

4. Three to five relevant visual symbols.

5. The geometric behaviors that best communicate
   the subject.

6. Which letters offer the most promising
   opportunities for transformation.

SEMANTIC TRANSFORMATION:

If the subject represents:

MOTION:
Use directional strokes, displacement, repeated
contours, kinetic breaks, and rhythmic geometry.

NATURE:
Translate growth, branching, organic repetition,
and environmental forms into letter anatomy.

SCIENCE:
Use scientific geometry, orbital paths, schematic
forms, diagrams, and precision linework.

MUSIC:
Incorporate visual rhythm, wave structures,
oscillations, and musical relationships.

ARCHITECTURE:
Transform stems and counters into arches,
structural supports, beams, and architectural voids.

TECHNOLOGY:
Use mechanical precision, circuitry, modular
systems, communication patterns, or interface geometry.

EMOTION:
Use spatial tension, expansion, compression,
contrast, distortion, or expressive continuity.

HISTORY:
Use carefully selected era-specific geometric
or typographic influences.

ABSTRACT CONCEPTS:
Invent a meaningful visual metaphor and
translate it into letter construction.

OTHER SUBJECTS:
Infer a unique transformation appropriate
to the subject's actual meaning.

LETTERFORM CONSTRUCTION:

Start with a custom geometric uppercase wordmark.

Transform selected characters through:

- parallel stroke multiplication
- interrupted or fragmented stems
- negative-space symbols
- custom ligatures
- extended horizontal bars
- geometric letter substitutions
- contour-line repetition
- directional stroke bending
- optical illusion effects
- embedded subject-specific pictograms
- carefully controlled line thickness
- mathematical relationships between shapes

Preserve character recognition.

At least two characters should exhibit
meaningful custom transformations.

Every transformation must serve the
concept rather than exist as decoration.

COMPOSITION:

Present ONE unified wordmark centered within
a generous white canvas.

Use a horizontal composition for longer names.

Use a compact stacked lockup when the text
naturally benefits from multiple lines.

Allow selected characters to extend beyond
the standard letter height when necessary.

Maintain carefully balanced optical spacing.

Let negative space contribute as much
as the black geometry.

VISUAL STYLE:

- pure black lettering
- clean white background
- high-contrast vector-like precision
- crisp geometric contours
- controlled thin parallel lines
- variable stroke density
- subject-driven symbolic elements
- elegant modular structure
- visually clever typographic surprises

STRICT RULES:

No unnecessary illustrations.
No photographic objects.
No gradients.
No 3D extrusion.
No decorative backgrounds.
No mockups.
No unrelated symbols.
No default electrical motifs.

Do not sacrifice readability for cleverness.

OUTPUT:

A visually ingenious minimalist typographic
identity for $ SUBJECT where the wordmark itself
becomes a symbolic machine, diagram, sculpture,
or optical expression of the subject.

Elegant from far away.
Surprisingly intelligent up close.
Immediately recognizable.
Distinctly original.

entries.title: "Secret Shadow" Instant Photo
entries.titleZh: 「秘密影子」拍立得
entries.prompt:
Create one "Secret Shadow" image per upload. Never combine photos.

Format: Vertical 16:9, presented as a single instant-film photo with a slightly thicker ivory bottom border.

Photo: Keep the uploaded photo faithful. Preserve the subject, pose, faces, colors and setting. Do not redesign, restyle or replace anything. Only adjust light and shading as much as the shadow requires.

Light: Add one low, warm, late-afternoon light source from the side, consistent with the scene, so the main subject casts a long, crisp shadow across the nearest wall, floor or ground.

Shadow Logic: Ask what this subject secretly wishes it were doing right now, based on what the photo shows. The shadow does exactly that. For example, a person at a laptop might cast the shadow of someone asleep in a hammock, a dog waiting by the door might cast the shadow of a dog driving a car, and a coffee cup might cast the shadow of a smoking volcano. Choose one clear, specific, surprising wish for each upload. Never fall back on the same idea.

Shadow Rules: The shadow must begin exactly where the subject touches the surface and match its outline at the base, then transform as it stretches away. It must behave like a real shadow: dark, soft-edged, flat on the surface it falls on, bending over steps and corners, with no color or inner detail. Only the main subject gets a secret shadow; everything else casts normal shadows.

Caption: Handwrite one short, dry, witty English caption in black ink on the bottom border, based on the shadow's wish. Under six words, understated, never inspirational.

Style: Real photography, warm golden light, subtle film grain, quiet and cinematic. It should feel like the shadow was always there and nobody noticed.

Negative: No extra subjects or props, no colored or detailed shadows, no glow or magic effects, no change to faces or identity, no text except the caption, no watermark, no logo, no UI.
